description.value: COBS Bread at Lonsdale Quay Market is a franchise bakery located inside the covered Lonsdale Quay Market, part of the Bakers Delight family with over 190 Canadian locations. All products — including loaves, buns and rolls, bagels, scones, cruffins, croissants, and savoury baked items — are made from scratch on-site daily. Leftover baked goods are donated to local charities at end of day.
